name: A Bump in the Road
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Trackmaster Zherin needs the growing beasts kept from the track. You are asked to thin the Saltstone Basilisks, Crystalhides and Gazers before they wander onto it.

sections.title: Keeping the Track Clear
sections.body:
A basilisk once struck the goblins' racer, the Red Thunder. After the crash, Kronkrider hired Zherin to watch over the Mirage Raceway track. Zherin does not know what the beasts on the Shimmering Flats are eating. He knows only that they have grown too big.

Their numbers must be kept down before one strays onto the course during a race. Clearing wreckage is bad enough. Zherin would rather not pick burnt animal parts out of it as well.

faq.answer: Trackmaster Zherin looks after the Mirage Raceway track on the Shimmering Flats. Kronkrider hired him for the work.

faq.q: Why are the basilisks being hunted?
faq.answer: The beasts on the flats have grown big, and one straying onto the track during a race could cause a crash. A basilisk already collided with the goblins' Red Thunder.
The Red Thunder is a racer belonging to the goblins. A basilisk collision wrecked it.

faq.q: Where are the basilisks usually found on the flats?
faq.answer: Basilisks roam all over the Shimmering Flats, but gather more thickly near Weazel's Crater and among the Tahonda Ruins.
